notes: §1985:XV.2.1.3 GR2: without WITH DEBUGGING MODE 'any USE FOR DEBUGGING statements and all associated debugging sections are compiled as if they were comment lines'. At 85 (Frontend passes debuggingSectionsAreComments where UseForDebuggingRemoved2002 is available) DebuggingLineRewriter#Rewrite finds each declarative section whose first sentence is USE FOR DEBUGGING (DebuggingSections) and Resolve moves its tokens off the default channel unless the unit or a containing unit declares the mode (§1985:VI.4.3.4 GR1); ProcedureTableBuilder#DeclCollectSection skips such a section as a second guard, and DataBinder#BindDeclarations with ConfigurationStep#Inherit carry the mode into contained programs. Probes at 85: without the mode a debugging section holding an undefined data-name, an undefined ON procedure, 'MOVE TO TO.', an unclosed literal and stray characters compiles and never runs, and a USE AFTER ERROR section beside it still runs after a failed OPEN (35); with the mode the section runs on ALL PROCEDURES, on a paragraph and on ALL REFERENCES (DEBUG-NAME, DEBUG-CONTENTS); a contained program inherits the mode, a separately compiled program after END PROGRAM does not; at 2002/2023 the section is COBOL0902. The witness, without the mode, prints MAIN only. || REFUTED: PARTIAL (over-rejects): at --std 85 with no WITH DEBUGGING MODE, the characters *> inside a debugging section (and in a debugging line, §1985:VI.4.3.4 GR5) draw COBOL0900, although the text is compiled as comment lines and a comment line may hold any characters. kb/Work PB5588 holds the defect (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-10.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-10-refute.json; rerun op-20261114/records-rs5b/rerun-log.txt).
